name: smwgraphics-technicolor-blocky-set
title: Technicolor Blocky Set
description:
A tileset made of colorful small blocks, best used in bonus areas. Fits well with most vanilla palettes. Uses the second half of BG2.

For the upside-down slopes to work properly, it is recommended to set the index of graphics in Header to something other than "Normal 1" or "Normal 2".
